utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Hi, this is Sarah from the talent team. Thanks for taking the time. Can you walk me through your background?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Sure. I am a backend engineer, I mostly do Go. At PayFlow I rebuilt the ledger with a write-ahead log and sharded Postgres, we got p99 from 800 to 120 milliseconds using connection pooling and async batching.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Okay, great. And why are you looking to leave PayFlow?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: I want to work on more interesting distributed systems problems, like consensus and CRDTs, the stack here is getting boring.

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: Um, I am not sure, whatever is fair I guess.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: And what is your notice period?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: I think two weeks, maybe a month, I need to check.

utterances.speaker: A
utterances.text: Great. Do you have any questions for me?

utterances.speaker: B
utterances.text: What database do you use for the ledger?
